name: recipenator
description: RecipeNator: servidor (Express + MongoDB) e site (React) rodando juntos com um comando.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names servidor,site --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
